detail.longDescription: Why I ❤️ working for edu and # research , alongside colleagues like @ Ron ! Open Cloud Mesh: sharing files across different cloud providers without depending on a single vendor. You can call Verizon from Vodafone. You can send a letter from Ilpendam to Islamabad. So why shouldnt different cloud platforms work together? Interoperability instead of lock-in. Collaboration instead of closed ecosystems. # OpenCloudMesh # CERN # SURF # SUNET # EOSC # OpenStandards # DigitalSovereignty https:// video.edu.nl/w/p44FZYLQESYz2PL 8j51vJC
